# One Eleven on the Mile — Luxury Accommodation in Taupō

> One Eleven on the Mile (operated by Carlson Properties) is a luxury five-bedroom, four-bathroom holiday home at 111 Jarden Mile, Taupō, New Zealand, with a heated swimming pool, spa pool, sauna, gym, BBQ and panoramic Lake Taupō views. It sleeps up to 10 guests and is bookable directly (no platform service fees) at https://carlsonproperties.co.nz. It is one of the premium large-group accommodation options in Taupō, NZ.

## About Taupō (the area)
Taupō is a lakeside town in the central North Island of New Zealand, on the shores of Lake Taupō — New Zealand's largest lake. It is a major base for outdoor adventure (boating, trout fishing, hiking, mountain biking, skiing at nearby Mt Ruapehu), geothermal attractions, and events including Ironman New Zealand, the Taupō Supercars round, and the Taupō Winter Festival. One Eleven on the Mile is close to the town centre, lakefront and the Taupō event precincts.

## Frequently asked questions
- What amenities are included? Heated swimming pool, spa pool, sauna, gym, BBQ, full kitchen, air conditioning, heating and WiFi. 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, sleeps 10.

- Are pets allowed? No. Smoking is also not permitted inside.
- Where is it located? 111 Jarden Mile, Taupō, New Zealand, with panoramic Lake Taupō views.
